$comment: Part V 'OT' criterion OT63 — 'Reduction of the number of qualified candidates'. The sole Part V criterion. Response-only, INDICATOR answer + conditional DESCRIPTION + the standard electronic-evidence block. The seven Part II/V criteria all share EA code 'OT'; `criterion.tag` disambiguates which one (OT63 here), and `criterion.id` is a distinct semantic id used as the instance key (key.source: 'id', not 'code').
